entries.abstract: Dieter Hilprant, judge in the County of Hirschberg, confirmed the listed properties as the free property of Seligenporten Monastery. The record names extensive estates, churches, tithes, farms, and other holdings across the region. It appoints a group of secular and ecclesiastical authorities, including Konrad von Rosenberg, Vicar of Amberg, as protectors of the monastery’s possessions.
